description: Create a print order for a validated upload. Validates everything BEFORE any payment link is minted. Returns { order, order_token } — the order object has order_id, status, amount, and payment_url (the Razorpay link, present while awaiting_payment). Give payment_url to the human to pay (UPI/cards/netbanking). SAVE order_token — it is shown only once and is required for get_order and cancel_order. The order confirms automatically after payment; unpaid orders expire after 72 hours.

address.description: India shipping address (V1 ships within India only).

line1.description: Street address: flat or house, building, street, e.g. "12B, Lakeview Apartments, 4th Cross".

line2.description: Area or landmark (optional), e.g. "Indiranagar, near Metro station".

name.description: Recipient name as the courier should read it, e.g. "Priya Raman".

state.description: Indian state or union territory, e.g. "Karnataka".

client_reference.description: Your own order id, e.g. "shop-order-48213" (optional). For callers sending an API key it makes create_order idempotent: replaying the same reference returns the original order instead of printing a second copy (order_token is then null, it was shown at the original creation). A canceled, refunded or expired order releases its reference. Stored but not enforced for keyless callers.

copies.description: Required for sticker (1,000 to 10,000 pieces) and for flat-card/folded-card (10 to 5,000 cards, cheaper per card from 50, 250 and 500). Books, sticker-a3 and greeting-card-a5 take 1 to 20, every copy the same price, and only they may leave it out for 1 copy.

email.description: Buyer email, e.g. priya@example.com; receives the Razorpay payment notification.

finish.description: paperback/hardcover: the lamination, gloss (the default) or matte. flat-card/folded-card: matte (the default) or gloss, the coating of standard card or the lamination of laminated card. Ignored for other formats.

format.description: paperback (staple-pinned) / hardcover (perfect bound): storybook, 24-64 pages including the 4-page 300gsm cover (page 1 front cover, page 2 inside front, last two pages inside back and back). sticker: custom-cut stickers, a one-page PDF at A3, A4 or A5 (portrait or landscape) with the artwork on a white or transparent background; we cut around the artwork. flat-card: a flat greeting card at A4, A5, A6, 8×8 in, 7×5 in or 6×4 in; page 1 front, page 2 back (optional). folded-card: a greeting card folded once, A4, A5 or A6 folded; the PDF page is the open spread (A3, A4 or A5 landscape), page 1 outside (back left, front right), page 2 inside (optional). sticker-a3: one uncut A3 portrait sheet on sticker media, a platform wall chart (exactly 1 page, 842×1191 pt). greeting-card-a5: one personalised folded A5 card for platforms, one A4-landscape sheet printed duplex (exactly 2 pages, 859×612 pt incl. 3 mm bleed).

paper.description: paperback/hardcover: inside-page paper, 170gsm (standard, the default) or 300gsm (thick, costs more); every cover is 300gsm card; see price_table.paper_prices in get_catalog. flat-card/folded-card: standard (300 GSM coated card, the default) or laminated. Ignored for other formats.

upload_id.description: upload_id of a PDF that passed validation.
